name: Facet
text: Ship a single dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. This keeps the interface sleek and readable while giving users control, matching Manus’ competitive dark theme and Graphify’s interactive graph. The trade-off is extra code for the toggle, but it’s worth it for user preference and market fit.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t user control—it’s conflating *preference* with *performance*. A dark theme toggle adds friction for 90% of users who won’t change it, while the extra code slows load times, hurting the 10% who might care. Ship dark by default, log toggle usage for 30 days, and only add the feature if >15% switch—otherwise, drop it.
